objectSettings.addToObject: Add a setting to this object
objectSettings.addToModifier: Add a setting to this modifier
objectSettings.addToPart: Add a setting to this part
objectSettings.modifierEmpty: Add a setting to change it where the modifier overlaps the object, like more infill in one spot.
